function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
Electricity as a phenomenon has been known since antiquity (e.g., static electricity from amber), but its systematic scientific study began in the 17th–18th centuries. Key figures include:

| Scientist | Contribution |
|-----------|--------------|
| **William Gilbert** (1544‑1603) | First coined the term *electricus* and studied magnetism and static electricity. |
| **Benjamin Franklin** (1706‑1790) | Demonstrated the electrical nature of lightning (the kite experiment). |
| **Alessandro Volta** (1745‑1827) | Invented the voltaic pile (first battery). |
| **Luigi Galvani** (1737‑1798) | Discovered bioelectricity (nerve stimulation). |
| **Hans Christian Ørsted** (1777‑1851) | Showed that electric currents produce magnetic fields. |

So while no single person “discovered” electricity, these pioneers laid the foundations of modern electromagnetism.
